title: F03 — Capture
tagline: Capture end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.
intro: F03 · 20h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.

• Goal: Capture end to end: Domain → fake data → view models → real data → tests.

Steps

  1. Add <Screen>ViewModel.swift next to the view: @MainActor @Observable, use cases through @Injected.
  2. In the view, replace FakeData… with view-model state; keep the layout (visual finish is F16).
  3. Loading, empty (SDEmptyState) and error states; previews for each.
  4. Delete this feature's Fake* types from App/Fakes/FakeData.swift once nothing uses them.
  5. Hi-vis yellow only on the shutter; never blocks on upload state.

blocks.html:
4.1 Camera session and permissions
  • Goal: one AVCaptureSession behind CaptureSessionControlling, testable without a camera.
  • Spec: 02.1
ActionFileHolds
NewPackages/DataLayer/Sources/DataLayer/DataSources/Local/Capture/CaptureSessionControlling.swiftProtocol: configure, start, stop, capturePhoto
NewCapture/AVCaptureSessionController.swiftReal implementation on sessionQueue
NewCapture/CaptureState.swiftidle → configuring → ready → capturingPhoto

Steps

  1. Never startRunning() on main.
  2. Camera, mic, location permissions asked separately.
  3. Add NSCameraUsageDescription etc. via project.yml INFOPLIST_KEY_*.
4.2 Write to disk and SHA-256
  • Goal: each photo written to media/… and hashed before the DB row exists.
  • Spec: 02.2
ActionFileHolds
NewCapture/FileHasher.swiftStreams SHA-256 in 1 MB chunks
NewCapture/MediaStore.swiftPath media/<project>/<session>/<capture>.<ext>, .completeUnlessOpen, excluded from backup

Steps

  1. Write → close → hash → insert row (no row without a hash).
  2. GPS older than locationStaleAfter is nil.
4.3 Real logic behind the screens
  • Goal: swap fakes for SwiftData repositories and the real camera; run the airplane-mode demo.
ActionFileHolds
EditSiteLog/App/AppDependencies.swiftRegister SwiftData*Repository, AVCaptureSessionController

Steps

  1. Change registrations only; no view code changes.
  2. Airplane mode on a real device: project → 80 locations → capture.
  3. Tick the feature steps in ROADMAP.

Done when

  • 50 photos with flat memory
  • Relaunch shows every capture with its hash
